defs.meaning: 自治，自治权；独立自主，自主权

examples.en: She sets a high value on autonomy.
The six fractious republics are demanding autonomy.
examples.zh: 这六个不安分的加盟共和国要求自治。

examples.en: Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.
examples.zh: 每一位地区经理在各自主管的区域都享有相当大的自主权。
